infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Me But needs access to your photos so you can choose a photo to transform. For example, select a selfie to see yourself at a different age or in a different style.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Me But saves your transformed images to your Photos library.
infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Me But needs access to your camera to take a photo for transformation.

plugins.photosPermission: Me But needs access to your photos so you can choose a photo to transform. For example, select a selfie to see yourself at a different age or in a different style.
plugins.cameraPermission: Allow Me But to use your camera so you can take a photo to transform.
